svg.title: Ordered-Tetrad Working Table
svg.desc: Original ordered-ascus HTML/CSS artwork from the BPW ordered-centromere generator. Read spores left to right. + and a identify alleles; colors are schematic, not measured pigmentation. Exact source: ordered_generator_art.html.
svg.metadata: Original generator drawings captured at three times CSS size, quality-90 WebP. Counts and explanatory labels remain live SVG text. Source data: ordered_problem_data.json. Updated generator source SHA256: e5a07882fc10d2ad049534e4f6087368efce9786e07009b9cb34e318655aa822. Original pattern sequences and fixed counts retained. Intrinsic image proportions and mitotic-pair bracket positions follow measured current generator geometry.
